value.description: Discover the highest quality downhole tools and equipment at Ace Well Technology. Our products are designed to optimize performance and improve efficiency in your drilling operations.
value.main_text_excerpt:
Applying holding force downhole
To support the changing energy landscape, innovation and efficiency are required across the value chain.
At Ace, we are leading the way in cutting-edge downhole technology, revolutionizing the industry with our groundbreaking solutions.
During well construction and completion, we have created a superior method for attaching tools and accessories to the casing or completion string. The unique locking mechanism of the Ace Rachet Collar (ARC) is the patented platform which underpins our broader technologies.
Through the unrivalled holding force of ARC, our simple and effective range of tools support the structural integrity of your well.
We strive to be a force in all we do. 
We are Ace Well Technology.
Our processes ensure these tools are deployed and installed using time and carbon efficient methods. And our choices are driven by our commitment to supporting net zero targets and UN sustainability goals.

pages.title: About | Ace Well Technology
pages.main_text_excerpt:
About Ace
Acquired by Varel Energy Services in 2025, Ace Well Technology was originally founded in 2012 with the mission of creating a tool which was easy to install and could reliably anchor tools to tubing with an extremely high holding force. This led us to develop the Ace Ratchet Collar, the first 90,000 lb+ rated stop collar on the market.
Suitable even for close tolerance operations, ARC offers an effective solution for securely locking additional downhole components on to any tube. With no loose parts and no impact on drift, our ARC technology is suitable for use in the harshest of operating conditions.
From our headquarters in Stavanger, Norway, we use the Ace Ratchet Collar as the starting point for wider product development and have since launched a number of products that are built from the foundation of the ARC. We now offer a family of high-quality tools that are simple, cost-effective and easy to install.
We continue to dedicate ourselves to creating greater value for our customers through innovative product development that positively contributes to increased safety in operations and a reduction in carbon emissions.
With our roots in Oil and Gas, we are committed to playing our part in the energy transition and our tools are suitable for any well including those in CCS and Geothermal, where we have already completed a number of projects.
Our teams are located in Stavanger, Norway and Houston, USA with hubs coming soon for the Middle East and Africa, and Asia.  We work across the world to develop and maintain strong and lasting customer relationships.
We pride ourselves on our ability to meet the challenges of our customers, operating flexibly to minimize lead times, maximize inventory management and operational efficiency.

We are accountable to our customers, priding ourselves on strong relationships based on trust, reliability and the delivery of value-adding products.
We work closely together with our customers to proactively identify solutions to their well challenges.
We continue to foster a culture of innovation, constantly looking for ways to break the mould and develop extraordinary products.

pages.title: People | Ace Well Technology
pages.main_text_excerpt:
People
Delivering industry-leading products is only possible thanks to our people. With a broad selection of backgrounds, we all share a common interest in innovation and technology, dedicated to creating an industry-leading organisation with exceptional products.
Management Team
Joachim Åkesson
Sales Director Europe & Africa / General Manager, Norway
Joachim joined Ace Well Technology as Sales Manager in August 2016.
Prior to joining Ace he had roles within sales, project management and operations at Tesco Corporation, Smith Services and Franks International.
Mohamed S. Ibrahim
Supply Chain & Operations Manager
Mohamed has a BSc in Petroleum Engineering and an MSc in Supply Chain Management.
He joined Ace Well Technology as Supply Chain Lead in August 2024.
Prior to joining Ace he had roles within NOV, Lundin and Petro Energy E&P.
Anbjørn Kaurstad
Technology Manager
Anbjørn joined Ace Well Technology as Technology Manager in March 2020.
Prior to joining Ace he worked at, and was a board member of, Roxel Products. He also had roles within Automation and Instrument Engineering at NOV and Industrial Control Systems.
Anne Grete Roen
Accounting Manager
Anne Grete is a state-authorized accountant and joined Ace Well Technology as Accounting Manager in January 2025.
Prior to joining Ace she had roles with Ramboll, Westco and Aveva.
Sales Representatives
Joachim Åkesson
Sales Director Europe & Africa / General Manager, Norway
Joachim joined Ace Well Technology as Sales Manager in August 2016.
Prior to joining Ace he had roles within sales, project management and operations at Tesco Corporation, Smith Services and Franks International.
Lasse Benjamin Jokela
Sales Manager Asia
With an engineering degree in Petroleum Technology, Lasse has ample experience as a Project Engineer at Weatherford, as well as several years as a Marketing Specialist at Innodisk.
Not only that, but he holds a bachelor's degree in China Studies and Chinese Languages.
Zaque Araújo Jr.
BD Manager Brazil
Zaque has a DSc in Geological and Earth Sciences/Geosciences and a MSc in Geology/Geophysics.
He joined Ace Well Technology as Business Development Manager in August 2024.
Prior to joining Ace he had roles within Tracero Ltd, Indra and Repsol Sinopec.
